text:
alex: quick heads-up, hitting a weird schema validation failure when using JSON mode + the SDK function-calling helper in the Python SDK. reproducible in our sample app.
priya: ugh, details? stack trace or snippet?
aj: paste below — minimal repro: using json_mode=True and passing a schema to the helper, the helper sends function_call.arguments as a plain string instead of parsed json in some cases. error: "SchemaValidationError: expected object for 'order', got string"
alex: exact client call: 
```py
client.chat.completions.create(
  model=...,
  messages=[{"role":"user","content":"create order"}],
  json_mode=True,
  functions=[...],
  schema=order_schema,
)
```
ben: interesting — in the JS SDK we parse function_call.arguments automatically when jsonMode is on, but the py helper currently just forwards the model output raw. parity bug?
priya: that would explain it. the model sometimes returns a JSON stringified field for nested objects and other times returns a proper JSON object depending on tokenization/decoding. if the SDK doesn't normalize that, schema validation fails.
jamie: also noticed a related retry/auth problem: if the request hits a transient 401 and the SDK retries, the function call may be executed twice downstream (the receiver sees duplicate webhook calls). we should add idempotency keys on function-call invocations.
alex: repro here: first request gets 401, the SDK retries once and resends same function call payload — downstream NLU replied twice. we need two fixes: normalize function_call.arguments to a parsed JSON object before schema validation + attach idempotency metadata when invoking user functions from SDK.
ben: agreed. small patch for py SDK: attempt json.loads on function_call.arguments if it's a string and json_mode is true, fall back if it raises. add tests for nested arrays/strings. i'll open PR.
priya: can we also add a lightweight helper util: sdk.helpers.parse_function_args(raw, *, schema=None) that returns (parsed, errors) and logs a single devex-friendly message when parsing failed? would make onboarding sample apps safer.
jamie: yes and add a retry policy change: on auth failures do not immediately re-execute side-effecting function calls without idempotency token. we should expose an optional idempotency_key param on the helper that the client can pass and that our runtime forwards as X-Idempotency-Key header.
ci-bot: ci: test run queued for branch alex/jsonmode-fix — 5 jobs.
alex: i'll add a tiny repro app under examples/sdk/json-mode-function-repro that demonstrates both the parsing mismatch and the duplicate-call case. includes a mock function endpoint to show duplicate requests.
ben: PR #4211 draft opened, includes: parse attempt, unit tests, docs note about idempotency. requesting review from @priya and @jamie.
priya: thanks — i'll review tonight. also can we add a quick note in the SDK migration guide for folks who rely on raw strings? some customers rely on stringified json for backwards compat. maybe opt-in strict parsing flag.
jamie: good call — default should be tolerant (parse if possible), and strict mode for those who want to enforce types. add warning in changelog.
alex: TL;DR: py sdk parity bug + retry-on-401 causing duplicate side-effects. action items: ben -> PR to parse function args, jamie -> runtime idempotency header support, priya -> docs/migration note, alex -> repro app + issue with customer example.
ben: 👍 will update PR with changelog entry.
priya: thanks all :rocket:
alex: filing a tracking issue: https://redwood.internal/issue/INF-827 (will update when PR merges).
